subrules.name: 702.194a
subrules.rule: Bleed is a static ability that functions while the card with bleed is on the stack. “Bleed (cost)” means “You may pay (cost) rather than pay this spell's mana cost as you cast this spell if an opponent lost life this turn.”

subrules.name: 702.194b
subrules.rule: Bleed only cares if an opponent lost life. If those opponents gained the life back, you can still cast a spell for its bleed cost. If your opponents have only lost glory counters and not life, you can't cast a spell for its bleed cost.

subrules.name: 702.202a
subrules.rule: Mirage represents two static abilities, one that functions while the card with mirage is on the stack, and one which may create a delayed triggered ability. “Mirage (cost)” means “You may cast this card as though it had flash by paying (cost) rather than its mana cost,” and “If this spell's mirage cost was paid, sacrifice the permanent this spell becomes at the beginning of the next cleanup step.”

subrules.name: 702.202b
subrules.rule: Permanents with mirage will leave the battlefield after damage is removed from permanents and 'until end of turn' and 'this turn' effects end.

subrules.name: 702.202c
subrules.rule: If the triggered ability of mirage is countered, it will not trigger again.

subrules.name: 702.205a
subrules.rule: Reprise is a static ability that functions while a card with reprise is in your graveyard. “Reprise (cost)” means “You may exile exactly one card with reprise from your graveyard as you cast an instant or sorcery spell. If you exile this card this way, copy this card's text box onto that spell and pay (cost) as an additional cost to cast that spell.”

subrules.name: 702.205b
subrules.rule: You can't choose to reprise a card if you can't make the required choices, such as targets, for that card's instructions.

subrules.name: 702.205c
subrules.rule: You can't ever exile two or more cards with reprise for a single spell.

Whenever one or more creatures you control attack and aren't blocked, this creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.

Any time you could cast an instant, you may cast this spell from your hand for {Cost} rather than pay its mana cost. If you cast this spell this way, sacrifice it at the beginning of the next cleanup step.
